body:
Changed after the second red team. The old idea (XP limits on tapping, furniture XP only the first time) would break the game:
- House floors need Decorating 10/20/30/40/50. Placing each furniture type once gives only 384 XP = level 9, so non-designers could never get floor 2.
- Most skills would need 100+ game days to reach level 30.
New: keep all XP as it is. With Balance 1 (level-ups pay a fixed 50), tapping only gives levels, not riches.
One fix stays: the school board 'Learn something new' works 8:00-20:00 like the library (now it works at any hour).

comments.text: Second red team: XP limits removed (they block house floors and slow every skill); only the school-hours fix stays.

Karolis said 'do the rebalance' in the Schedules and economy chat (30 Oct): approved. Built as a code patch (economy-rebalance.patch, build 2026103101) and checked with the quick kit; goes live through a pull request in the next repo chat.

short: No XP limits; school board open 8:00-20:00 only
source: chat 2026-10-30: Schedules and economy red team
title: Balance 2 (changed): no XP limits, only the school board follows school hours
